description: This file defines the SubscriptionTimeoutException class, a custom exception used within the org.eclipse.ditto.signals.commands.thingsearch.exceptions package. It represents errors related to subscriptions timing out due to inactivity, providing methods for creating instances from error messages and JSON objects, and includes a builder class for constructing instances.
external_methods: DittoRuntimeException.fromJson(JsonObject jsonObject, DittoHeaders dittoHeaders, Builder builder)

classes.name: SubscriptionTimeoutException
classes.description: Custom exception indicating a subscription timeout due to lack of interaction, extending DittoRuntimeException and implementing ThingSearchException.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an instance of SubscriptionTimeoutException with a message indicating the specific subscription has stopped due to inactivity.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs a SubscriptionTimeoutException from a JSON object and message headers.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance of SubscriptionTimeoutException with the specified DittoHeaders, preserving other properties.
